'''Imlok''' was a corporation that active during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It produced some of the most sophisticated tactical monitoring technology of the time, such as the [[ARENA-7580]].<ref name="IAotC">{{InsiderCite|66|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones'': Geonosian War Chamber}}</ref>
